research_method: Official provider release/news/changelog/API/pricing/model documentation checked; dates copied as displayed. When publication time/timezone is absent, neither is inferred. Findings are limited to the listed pages and are not a claim that no announcements exist elsewhere.

items.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
items.notes: OpenAI says Google Cloud Model Garden access is planned; purchases via Google Cloud Marketplace and existing GCP spend commitments may be used. Page says general availability is expected in the coming weeks. No exact publish time or timezone.

items.title: Google Cloud brings OpenAI models to customers
items.notes: Google lists GPT-Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna as rolling out in private preview to select enterprise customers; API access and local Codex CLI/Desktop integration with Gemini platform; Marketplace billing, GCP commitment drawdown/Flexible Savings Plans. Google states dedicated Cloud infrastructure and data-perimeter/no-training controls; ZDR and Confidential Compute coming soon. Specific Model Garden API IDs/endpoints, per-model prices/units, rate limits, available regions, exact preview expansion and license/weight terms are not provided in this announcement. Company statements are not independent verification.

items.title: Models catalog, direct OpenAI API route
items.notes: Direct OpenAI API catalog lists GPT-6 Astra / gpt-6-astra at $10 input and $50 output per 1M tokens; GPT-6.1 Sol / gpt-6.1-sol at $2/$10 per 1M tokens; GPT-6 Luna / gpt-6-luna at $0.10/$0.50 per 1M tokens. These are direct OpenAI API prices and IDs, not evidence of Google Cloud Model Garden endpoint IDs or preview pricing. Direct API rate limits vary by usage tier.

items.title: API changelog
items.notes: Oct 21: projects can choose allowed service tiers, with organization settings able to restrict tiers across projects. Oct 20: optional 12-hour prompt caching in Responses API; cache writes cost 2.5x the input token price. These are API feature updates, not a model launch.

items.title: Talk to anyone, in any language, in realtime
items.notes: Eleven Realtime Translation live voice translation model is announced in alpha for ElevenAPI enterprise customers. Company says it uses Eleven v4 Turbo by default and describes 90+ languages / automatic language detection / 17,500+ voices; these are vendor claims. Announcement does not list public price, regional availability, rate limits, or a stable model ID/endpoint in the checked page.
